reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: src/command.rs owns the ungot linked queue and retained command-mode globals; ungetcc allocates character nodes and publishes them through the head, while curropt only borrows a static option descriptor.
owner_creation.invariant: Queue node ownership is distinct from borrowed option and position values.
limitations: This file review does not infer ownership from every global pointer type.

aliases_escapes.analysis: src/command.rs tail insertion retains a raw pu node while traversing the chain; get_ungot can unlink and free the head. Option and display state also remain shared across direct calls.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Queue traversal must not overlap an entry that retires its nodes.
limitations: A byte copied out of get_ungot does not keep the consumed node alive.

callback_targets.analysis: src/command.rs ungetsc is called directly by sigusr after environment lookup, and enters ungetcc_back for every byte. The cross-file handler path reaches allocation rather than merely setting a notification.
callback_targets.invariant: The asynchronous producer must hand off work before allocating nodes.
limitations: The concrete existing route remains M0-SIG-002.

invalidation.analysis: src/command.rs consumption updates ungot to its successor before freeing the old node; queued character aliases end at this free even when another command action still has a raw list cursor.
invalidation.invariant: A removed node address cannot be retained after consumption.
limitations: This does not establish that all queued nodes are consumed before process exit.

mutation_commit.analysis: src/command.rs publishes head insertion after setting character/successor fields, while tail insertion updates an existing node link. These separate writes have no main-loop-only ownership token.
mutation_commit.invariant: Queue publication and command-mode changes require serialized access.
limitations: Staging one node does not make a whole command-string enqueue atomic.

release_pair.analysis: src/command.rs pairs ecalloc node creation with free in get_ungot; source strings passed to ungetsc remain borrowed and their bytes are copied into nodes, not retained as string owners.
release_pair.invariant: Node release must not free the borrowed producer string.
limitations: Other shell/option owners are separate from this queue release pair.

error_cleanup.analysis: src/command.rs can enqueue earlier characters before allocation of a later character fails. No local rollback returns the queue to its previous command boundary; polling elsewhere does not undo published nodes.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure handling must account for already published input actions.
limitations: This is a source transaction limitation, not a newly reproduced queue failure.

signals_handoff.analysis: src/command.rs receives SIGUSR1 producer work through sigusr, which calls ungetsc before intio. M0-SIG-002 and the broader M0-MEM-001 queue alias obligation stay open despite notification support.
signals_handoff.invariant: Notification after mutation is not deferred mutation ownership.
limitations: No signal or command-source fix is made by this ownership batch.

src/signal.rs.relationship: sigusr at src/signal.rs:86-100 calls ungetsc and then intio. The command queue allocates and links nodes during that direct asynchronous producer call.
